description: Extract all text from a PDF. Send as pdf_base64 (base64-encoded PDF, max ~10 MB decoded). Returns text (full concatenated text), pages array (per-page text + char_count), page_count, and metadata (title, author, creator). Encode with: Buffer.from(pdfBytes).toString('base64'). Ideal for RAG pipelines, document QA, or LLM ingestion. Price: $0.004 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"pdf_base64":"<base64 of a PDF>","max_pages":10}.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to extract. Default: 50. Use to limit processing time for large PDFs.

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF file content. Decode a PDF file to base64 and pass it here. Max ~10 MB (unencoded).

name: pdf_extract
title: PDF Text Extraction
